map.由现值、利率与年数求投资未来值: Find the future value of an investment from the present value, interest rate and number of years
map.输入现值 PV、年利率 r 与年数 n，求未来值。: Enter the present value PV, the annual interest rate r and the number of years n to obtain the future value.
map.📖 查看「由现值、利率与年数求投资未来值 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Find the future value of an investment from the present value, interest rate and number of years" guide
map.一次性投入的复利终值。: Compound future value of a one-off investment.
map.📚 深度解析：投资未来值（复利）: 📚 In-depth analysis: investment future value (compound interest)
map.一次性本金按复利算未来值。: Future value of a one-off principal at compound interest.
map.对比不同利率/年限的增值。: Compare growth across different rates and terms.
map.一次性投入后按复利滚动，估算到期的本息合计。: After a one-off investment, roll it up at compound interest to estimate total principal and interest at maturity.
map.FV = 10000×1.08¹⁰ = 10000×2.1589 ≈ 21589: FV = 10000×1.08¹⁰ = 10000×2.1589 ≈ 21589 CNY. That is, 10 thousand at 8% compound interest for 10 years becomes about 21.6 thousand.
map.本金 50000 元，年利率 6%，投资 10 年: Principal 50000 CNY, annual rate 6%, invested for 10 years
FV=50000×(1.06)¹⁰≈89542.38 CNY, of which 39542.38 CNY is interest, already more than 79% of the principal.
map.复利和单利差多少？: How much do compound and simple interest differ?
map.单利 10 年只 1.8 万；复利 2.16 万，利息再生息的差距随年限放大。: Simple interest over 10 years gives only 18 thousand; compound gives 21.6 thousand, and the gap from interest earning interest widens with the term.
map.按年计息换成按月计息怎么算？: How do I switch from annual to monthly compounding?
map.把年利率除以计息次数、期数乘以计息次数：按月复利为 FV=PV(1+r/12)^: Divide the annual rate by the number of compounding periods and multiply the number of periods: with monthly compounding FV=PV(1+r/12)^(12n). The example above becomes about 90969.84 CNY with monthly compounding, 1427.46 CNY more than annual.
